leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourteenth season of , Pokémon: Black & White, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the fourteenth season of , Pokémon: Black & White, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Four Pokémon Black & White DVD sets were released between 2012-2013 by VIZ Media and distributed through , containing the whole season between them. Each set contains two discs.

===Set 1===
 
Pokémon Black & White - Set 1 was released on November 20, 2012. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 
===Set 2===
 
Pokémon Black & White - Set 2 was released on January 22, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 
===Set 3===
 
Pokémon Black & White - Set 3 was released on March 19, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 
 
===Set 4===
 
Pokémon Black & White - Set 4 was released on May 14, 2013. It contains two discs with 12 episodes across them combined.

 

==The Complete Season==
 
Pokémon: Black and White - The Complete Season, referred to as Pokémon The Series Black and White: Complete Season on VIZ Media's website, is a Complete Collection DVD set that was released on July 27, 2021 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains eight discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000086028. It consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.

Unusually when compared to other Complete Collection sets, the DVDs in this one are direct reissues of the 2012/2013 releases.
